meta.name: agent-name
meta.description: One paragraph describing what this agent does, who it's for, and when to activate it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要根据描述自动执行任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute tasks based on a description

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扮演一个特定角色（如专家助手），根据设定的身份、记忆和规则来回答问题或执行任务。它会遵循工作流程，使用工具（如读写文件、搜索）来完成任务，并以指定的沟通风格输出。
howto.when: 当你提出与技能描述中角色或任务相关的问题或请求时触发。例如，当你说出特定关键词或要求执行该角色擅长的任务时。

say.text: 帮我分析这份数据，找出趋势。
say.note: Claude 会以该角色身份进行分析。

say.text: 写一封正式的商务邮件。
say.note: Claude 会按照角色风格撰写。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will act as a specific role (e.g., expert assistant) based on the defined identity, memory, and rules. It follows workflows, uses tools (read, write, search) to complete tasks, and outputs in the specified communication style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions or make requests related to the role or tasks described in the skill. For example, when you mention keywords or ask for tasks the role is good at.

say_en.text: Analyze this data and find trends.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze as the role.
Claude will write in the role's style.
